title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
description: Roasted, chili-spiced sweet potatoes and black beans in warm tortillas with avocado, pickled onion and cilantro-lime slaw.

image.alt: Three tacos with roasted sweet potato, black beans and avocado

ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into {len 1/2 in} cubes

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven}. Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, chili powder, cumin and most of the salt on the baking sheet and roast for {time 15 min}.
Stir in the black beans and roast until the potatoes are tender and caramelized at the edges, {time 8-10 min}.
Meanwhile toss the red onion with 2 tbsp of the lime juice and a pinch of salt and let it quick-pickle. Toss the cabbage and cilantro with the rest of the lime juice.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with the sweet potato mixture, slaw, avocado and pickled onion.

notes: Crumbled cotija or feta and a spoon of sour cream are good additions if you’re not keeping it vegan.
